source.surface: third-party app authorisation, data-egress scopes listed and not yet granted
source.attribution: Screen curated by Mobbin (https://mobbin.com). Inspected remotely through the Mobbin MCP under accessMode 'remote-mcp'. No image was downloaded, cached, embedded, or stored anywhere in this repository; every value below is our own reading of the rendered screen.

evidenceTier.rationale: Mobbin is a curated gallery of captured screens. It is not a live observation we made of a running product, and no audience outcome is attached, so it cannot be silver/M2 or gold/M3. Treat these facts as evidence that a shipped product once looked this way, not as evidence that it worked.

decisionColour.acceptControlTreatment: solid blue fill with a white label
decisionColour.rejectControlTreatment: Decline, an outlined control of the same size and shape with no fill, placed immediately to the right of Allow
decisionColour.undecidedContainerTreatment: the scope card is plain white with a hairline border and carries no tint of the grant colour
decisionColour.optionalGrantDefault: unchecked — the additional-permission checkbox is in its off state before the user acts
decisionColour.verdict: The only consent surface in this corpus where an optional grant is NOT pre-granted. The grant colour is confined to the Allow button, the scope card stays neutral, and the two dispositions are the same size so only the fill distinguishes them.
